rulings.ruling: Ruling: refusal representation; project retained. The project gives the credit as the smaller of creditable foreign taxes and the tax on line 16 when any foreign tax exists, and refuses the return through the election gates (not all passive, no election, not eligible, statements not received, taxes over the no-Form-1116 limit, i1116 pp. 1–2) rather than returning zero. The second transcription folds those conditions into the credit as zero. Within the non-refused scope the values agree.
